description: Ministry of Justice - Regulation made under Section 60 of the Judicature Act No. 02 of 1978 (Enforcement of Fmancial Statutes of Eastern Province)
categorisation: This gazette content contains regulations made by the Minister of Justice under the Judicature Act, specifically amending court jurisdiction for tax-related matters in the Eastern Province. This constitutes legal/regulatory matters involving statutory instruments and amendments to existing regulations, fitting Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes). While it mentions a government minister, it does not focus on personnel changes or portfolio assignments, but rather on the regulatory content itself.
